subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Pipeline and Energy Threats
description: A quick, practical guide to Pipeline and Energy Threats.

hook.text: Colonial Pipeline paid DarkSide $4.4 million in Bitcoin to restore operations after a ransomware attack.

buildup.text: The 2021 attack shut down the largest fuel pipeline in the US for six days, causing panic buying.

discovery.text: The attackers entered through a single compromised VPN password with no multi-factor authentication.

twist.text: The FBI recovered most of the ransom by tracing and seizing the Bitcoin wallet — a rare win.

climax.text: One weak password shut down fuel supply for the eastern US. Cyber risk to energy is existential.

punchline.text: One password. Six days. No fuel for the East Coast.

quiz.question: How did attackers breach Colonial Pipeline?
options: Through a compromised VPN password without MFA
By physically tampering with the pipeline
Through a supply chain software update
